name: Ryoujoku Shiokinin
source:
Main heroine's father remarries a young woman. She gets both company and mansion after father's sudden death. The girl runs away from the mansion after hearing that she is going to be sold to yakuza the next day...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主要女主角的父亲与一位年轻女子再婚。父亲突然去世后，她得到了陪伴和豪宅。少女得知第二天自己将被卖给黑帮后，逃离了宅邸……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
